policies.text: An item cleared for commercial distribution satisfies international commercial readiness provided the producer maintains active ISO 13485 quality management certification.
A product satisfying international commercial readiness is eligible for inclusion in the corporate buying registry if indemnity coverage reaches at least $5 million.
Packaged foodstuffs achieve natural rating status provided organic ingredient proportion is no less than 90%.
Photovoltaic equipment receives sustainable energy incentive funding when panel efficiency equals or exceeds 22%.
Heavy machinery obtains site safety clearance provided operational noise levels remain under 80 decibels.
A medical device gains commercial distribution clearance either via European CE mark certification or through US FDA 510(k) clearance.
Cold storage units receive pharmaceutical storage compliance if internal temperature stability is maintained within 2 to 8 degrees Celsius.
Light mobility vehicles earn municipal transit clearance if crash safety evaluation scores reach 5 stars.
